scope: Browser CI cleanup claim consumption and AutoRemove reconciliation
confirmed_gaps: Successful or already-empty cleanup retained reusable same-run creation authority
Stopping an owned compose run --rm helper can remove it before an unconditional container rm, interrupting network/volume cleanup

behavior.claim: Unlink only after all validated cleanup operations finish successfully, including an already-empty owned state. Retain on validation, Docker, identity or cleanup deadline failure. A later no-claim cleanup performs no inventory or deletion.
behavior.container_identity: The inspected full IDs must exactly match the validated inventory. Inspect AutoRemove and reconcile only those exact full IDs before stop and after stop/remove; names or replacement IDs never gain authority.
behavior.automatic_removal: Wait for naturally auto-removed helpers to disappear inside the existing cleanup deadline; skip a redundant rm and continue verified network/volume cleanup.
behavior.errors: A nonzero stop/remove is reconciled only through a healthy exact-ID absence observation. A still-present target, daemon/query error, replacement ID or timeout fails and retains the claim.
behavior.limits: Existing ownership-read deadline55s and deletion deadline120s unchanged. AutoRemove polling sleeps at most0.1s within that remaining deadline. No force deletion or broad Compose sweep.

verification.original_output_source: Untruncated retained command output from the final source run, not a reconstruction or additional run
new_cases: Success and already-empty claim consumption, later matching-name resources protected by no-claim no-op
Validation, real stop/remove, network/volume deletion failures retain claim
Immediate and delayed stop-to-AutoRemove continue exact network/volume cleanup without redundant container rm
Natural exact-ID disappearance before stop and during stop/remove
Reconciliation daemon errors and replacement-ID rejection retain claim
AutoRemove cleanup deadline exhaustion retains claim and does not remove remaining targets
verification.prior_checks: All existing collision/claim/resource/secret/staging/shared-suite deadline tests remain; original26/30/43 proof files unchanged

acceptance: Source and pure mocked evidence only. Exact-head reviewer recheck remains required before CI; this candidate does not self-clear the source hold.
rollback: No schema or production changes. Focused runner/test delta; prior candidates/proof remain immutable historical checkpoints with their documented lifecycle gaps.
